Do gods really choose saints like you pick your next meal?
There are great powers at work beneath the surface, this is their world, and you're living in it.
Follow Sofia as she unknowingly gets tangled in power struggles far beyond what she had bargained for.
Be ready for a wild ride. Break a leg, skeleton!
sexy-isekai-one-piece-most-wanted:
What would happen if you found yourself in One Piece as a Side character ?What would you do if your cheats were not actual cheats, instead you got scientific knowledge. Would you accept your life as a side character? Would you stay low key and mind your own business? Or would you throw yourself into the plot and change it to your benefit? This is a story about a man that had those options.
Blerd finds himself in one of his favourite animes , One Piece. If you seen an add offering transmigration services to other worlds don't click it! At best it's spam at worst it's real. Some things are better as a work of fiction. Why? Smart Isekai is an ad that has you choose an anime world and challenge it with No golden fingers no quick power ups. You have to use you brain to think of creative ways you can challenge the world with no cheats but as a Native. I chose to challenge the world of One Piece. Now I am really in One Piece how the heck am I gonna survive ?
skeleton-knight-in-another-world: The protagonist fell asleep while playing an online game. However, he awoke in a strange world with his game character’s appearance. In a state of shock, he noticed that he was equipped with nothing but his strongest weapon and armor. To make matters worse, our hero’s appearance was changed by the special avatar skin『Skeleton』when he entered this new world. The protagonist wanted to live without drawing attention, but he got acquainted with the dark elf Ariana and received her request.
sss-rank-bloodline-wolf-evolution:
Arthur Grafton expected many things from life.
A stable job someday. Maybe a girlfriend. Possibly lower internet bills.
Waking up as a wolf in the middle of a nightmare forest was not on the list.
Thrown into a savage world filled with monsters, bloodshed, and predators lurking behind every shadow, Arthur is forced to survive with nothing but instinct, sharp fangs, and a mysterious System that appeared in his head at the worst possible moment.
[Login Successful]
[You have received a Login Package]
Because apparently being traumatized once wasn’t enough.
Every hunt is a gamble between predator and prey. One mistake means torn flesh, shattered bones, and becoming another corpse swallowed by the forest. There are no easy victories here only hunger, fear, and the terrifying realization that something far deadlier may be hunting him in return.
This is a dark survival fantasy focused on struggle, evolution, brutal growth, and a protagonist slowly adapting to a world that feels determined to eat him alive.
starting-from-a-fake-university:
Ding Yue had just traversed into the Parallel World and flunked his College Entrance Examination.
To avoid his parents' double-punishment, Ding Yue forged an admission notice, created a fake university website, and rented a space near University Town to discretely run a counterfeit university in hope of fooling his parents.
Things didn’t go as expected.
On the first day of the term, the registration scene of his fake university surprisingly turned out to be a big hit...
PS: This is a story filled with light-hearted farming narrative, everyday life, extravagantly rich and talented characters, technology, and top students... Feel free to add it to your bookshelf if you like it, and don’t forget to leave a recommendation vote~
system-i-can-open-martial-arts-chests:
Chu Qing traverses into the Martial World and discovers he is being hunted by an Assassin organization.
Fortunately, he acquires an Assassin System.
By opening the Treasure Chest, he can obtain various Martial Arts Secret Techniques.
[Successfully opened, acquired Secret Technique: Ah Fei's Swift Sword!]
the-ace-bigshot-becomes-a-farmgirl:
Shu Yu transmigrated to become a mob character, exiled into oblivion after appearing twice after helping the female side character who kept trying to dig a deeper hole for herself.
Realizing she couldn't change the outcome, Shu Yu decided to just goof off.
But even before the exile came, she was suddenly told that she was not a daughter of the Shu family.
She was born to a farmer's family, who were so poor they couldn't afford to repair their leaking house. Having decided to eliminate the tarnishing of their good name, Shu Yu's adopted family decided to murder her.
Shu Yu: Come on, see who dies.
Returning to her biological family, the sight of a plate of salted vegetables, a barely-full bowl of rice, and her real parents' nervous looks, she finally sighed.
No more goofing off, or she's going to starve to death.
the-black-beasts-useless-concubine:
Banruo Village was all Bai Ye knew in her 15 years of existence in this world of magical beasts, fickle spirits, and mystical practice.
Growing up with only her grandfather as her support, her life was turned upside down when the old man was found murdered.
Following the tragedy, the man whom she loved since childhood betrayed her in the vilest way possible.
Bai Ye was left with no choice but to kill herself. Alas, even after being driven to the brink of despair, death eluded the young girl.
With her family blood awakened, she was prompted by a mysterious man to join the Erudition Trails in Imperial City in order to escape the tightening claws of her ex-fiancé.
the-destiny-villainess-wants-me-to-work:
Su Mo transmigrated to the world of urban cultivation novels with a system. As a passerby, he was not interested in the plot and didn’t want to get involved with the protagonists or the heroines.
What he didn’t know was that he himself was also a protagonist and the big villainess bound to a destiny villain system came to his door.
[Ding! Destiny Protagonist Detected: Su Mo]
[Please Make a Choice!]
[Whether to: 1) Kill! or 2) Subdue!]
Yang Qingxi looked at the system prompt in front of her and decisively clicked on…
***
Note: The beginning of the story is very similar to the plots of many novels out there in the same genre. Here I emphasize! They are not the same! As the story progresses, you will understand.
This story is set in a parallel world.
The names of many characters will be Chinese, but the story has very little Chinese culture elements.
I am not a Chinese so don’t have expectations regarding it. ＼(º □ º l|l)/
Everything in my story is based on my imagination and has nothing to do with any person, place, or religion. All similarities are coincidences. (¬‿¬)
Happy Reading!!! (＾▽＾)/
the-human-emperor:
Forcefully brought over from the modern world to an alternate world, Wang Chong felt detached and lived his life aimlessly.
However, when calamity struck and he saw his family and everything he cared for being torn apart, he felt regret.
Thus, he stood up and eventually became the Grand Marshal of the Central Plains, leading an army against those who seek to destroy all he cherished.
Yet, despite all his efforts, it was already too late to reverse destiny.
But before his death, a shooting star, the same one which brought him to this world, appeared before him, and he was given another chance to undo his regrets.
the-reincarnated-wizard-who-will-eventua:
‘Since I’m in a different world, I have no choice but to aim to be the strongest!’
Sam is a boy who was born into a noble family after being reincarnated into another world with memories of his previous life. He was born into an aristocratic family, and although he comes from a family of swordsmen, he is banished from his family because he has no talent with the sword. However, Sam has a rare talent as a wizard in this world!
‘If I can’t use a sword, I’ll use magic to become the strongest in the world!’
On his way, he has a fateful encounter with the self-proclaimed “Genius Wizard” Ur Scheidt.
Ur notices the magical talent that lies dormant within Sam and takes him as her disciple, saying ’I’ll train you.’ Sam and Ur lead a harsh but fun life, but one day their adventures come to an abrupt end…?!
the-undead-calamity-begins-with-a-gravey:
It all begins when Gu Su buys a bootleg version of a Graveyard Demon!
If you don't want to die in the game, you must find a way to fight for your life!
Scavenging, battling, developing the city; in the end, an Undead Calamity-level existence appears in this world where game and reality merge!
the-villainess-just-wants-to-clear-the-g:
[Reverse Harem + Strategy/Dating Sim + Fantasy Game + Multiple Playthroughs + Multiple Identities + All Endings Collection = The Villainess Charmer Who Wants It All.]
[The Female Lead Has No Morality.]
[The more male competition and dramatic showdowns, the better.]
After a car accident, Lilia's soul was trapped in a strange space.
Only by controlling a character and clearing all endings of the game “Holy Sanctuary” can she return to reality.
[First Playthrough]
You are a commoner with the worst Magic Talent. Relying on your considerable cunning and schemes, you become the young maidservant by the Earl's eldest son's side.
Everyone is captivated by you, and you successfully use the Earl's family as a stepping stone to max out the affection level of an incognito prince from another country.
Just as the Happy Ending is within your grasp, the Earl's eldest son returns, transformed into a gloomy tyrant.
“Have you had your fun?”
“A Canary should return to its cage.”
[Second Playthrough]
You are a Demon hidden in the human world, and you encounter a pitiful wretch raised from childhood to be a scapegoat.…
the-weakest-f-rank-who-breaks-the-system:
“In this world, your ranking isn’t just a number. It’s your status. It’s your life expectancy.”
Lucius was ranked #5 in the world, the most qualified candidate to become a god. Yet betrayal knows no bounds. Murdered by his best friend and his fiancée, his soul is cast into the body of a crippled young man with the lowest ranking in history.
[Last.]
Rejected and cast aside by his family because of his inability to use magic, Lucius finds himself in a familiar setting, yet covered in life-threatening wounds and with only a limited time left to live.
However, fate had a different plan for him.
Lucius acquired an unprecedented ability.
[Mana Symbiosis]
Everyone sees him as a flawed F-Rank who’s bound to die soon, but his ability allows him to fuse spells in creative ways.
In a world where magic comes pre-shaped, creating your own magic was impossible.
“If the system says I’m the Last, then I’ll have to break it.”
--
thunder-gods-reincarnation: He was able to repeatedly reincarnate due to the effect of the Nine Lives Reincarnation Spell, which allowed him to have nine lives. After defeating the Hell-Blood Demon who drove the entire murim to chaos, the patriarchs of the Seven Great Clans betrayed him and killed him. Following that, he was reincarnated for the ninth time as Baek Mu-Gun. Now, his last journey across murim begins.
villainess-marked-for-her-alpha:
I blinked awake in a penthouse suite overlooking neon-lit skyscrapers, my phone buzzing with notifications from the social feeds everyone obsesses over.
Yeah, me, Emily the broke barista, got herself transmigrated into 'Alphas' Eternal Knot,' that addictive novel about cutthroat elites in a world ruled by alpha-omega pheromones. Think corporate empires meets scandalous romance—alphas command boardrooms and hearts, omegas get lavish indulgence—or drama.
As 'villainess' Emily Leonhart, heir to a fashion dynasty, I was billed as a 'rare' female alpha—destined to sabotage the sweet omega heroine before the four alpha male leads exposed and ruined me. A cliché novel in which the villainess gets defeated—and boom! Everyone gets their own happy ending.
My plan? Well, it was simple... I mean, I didn't want to compete for the heroine with them. Then again, I don't have any interests in the male leads too.
But then, there was a plot twist—my heat slams in like a spotlight malfunction—flushes, tremors, total meltdown.
“I'm an omega?!” I gasped. Turns out the novel lied; my “alpha” aura didn't even exist! My predecessor was hiding her omega biology.…
villains-act-shamelessly-the-heiress-was:
Thea Shaw travels from the modern society to the Women's Respect Country, diligently working for thirty years to reach the position of Great National Master.
She is forced to travel back again.
Before traveling, she was the Miss Sutton who was mistakenly taken by another family, spending twenty years in the countryside, while a fake heiress replaced her in the elite Sutton Family.
Her parents are indifferent to her, relatives awkwardly look down on her, and the fake heiress is superior in every way, treating her with politeness.
Originally feeling indignant and extreme about her fate and ready to fight for everything, Thea's sharpness is blunted by thirty years of living in a female-dominant society.
She thinks, just get by, what else can you do?
So the Sutton Family is astonished to find that the daughter lost in the countryside for twenty years is not demanding her status or proving herself, but is instead waving the banner of feudalism.
Great National Master—controls national destiny, primarily fortune-telling, with a side of persuasion.…
weaves-of-ashes:
JAYDE
Forged in the crucible of Xi Corporation’s labs, Jayde—once known only as SN1098—is a genetically engineered super soldier, her body honed to a razor's edge through decades of fighting humanity’s brutal wars. Her rebellion against her creators sparked a desperate battle for her people’s survival, only to end in betrayal and a fiery death on Crypso 3Q3U, her sacrifice shattering the corporate chains binding thousands of GESS lives. Yet death is not her end. Jayde awakens, impossibly, in the tortured body of a young girl on a strange world untouched by the technology she knew—no starships, no replicators, no blasters, only the primal pulse of magic. Bound to an ancient artifact pulsing with secrets, she must navigate a realm of powerful mages, mythical creatures, and lurking monsters, her old instincts clashing with the arcane forces now at her command. Her soul, scarred by battle and betrayal, carries a darkness that threatens to consume or redeem her as she carves a new path.
REN
Ren, the fierce demon king, stands as the last bulwark against his race’s extinction, his heart a furnace of primal fury.…
westminster-bank:
I transmigrated.
I became a debt collector for a bank in Birmingham, United Kingdom, in the year 1987. My main task was to collect debts from debtors who refused to pay.
Thinking that since it was almost the 21st century, debt collection methods would probably be nothing more than freezing the other party's bank account or threatening to put them on a credit blacklist, I pushed open the debtor's door.
The one who opened the door was a mythical evil dragon.
She said: “I am willing to repay the debt.”
And so I became a Dragon Knight.
witch-monastery: Trapped in a monastery of breathtaking nuns, Charles recognizes them from Witch Monastery—they’re monsters in saintly disguises, hungry for his flesh.
